image_pattern_summary: Verified good images predominantly show completed metal shed structures photographed from a 3/4 exterior angle, with full wall and roof cladding visible (corrugated metal sheets in blue, grey, or green), large door openings, and windows along the side walls. Interior shots showing corrugated metal roofing on steel purlins and metal wall cladding are also accepted as good images. Construction-phase images showing only bare steel frames are present but classified as thin — they are accepted for the MCAT but provide less buyer value than completed-structure images.

reason: Metal sheds are large structures where the product appearance (span, cladding colour, door type, overall form) is the primary buyer information — no readable spec labels or text are printed on the structure itself.
All verified good images show structural forms (exterior cladding, frame, doors) rather than any text-bearing surfaces, confirming OCR would extract no useful product data.
